day.headline: A Rat day — Dragon and Monkey are in step.

reasons: Ox pairs with Rat — a harmonious day
signs.motif: a name that keeps coming up
signs.message: Third mention this week. Ask for the introduction today.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the quiet hour before everyone wakes
signs.message: Awake before the chat starts. That hour is yours, use it.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: shoes at the back of the wardrobe
signs.message: Dig out the good pair. Today deserves them, no occasion needed.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: She's not okay. Show up in person, bring nothing clever.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Sit by the glass today. Watch instead of scrolling.

reasons: Rat's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Pairs are breeding by the door. Ten minutes, sort them.

reasons: Dragon and Rat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a tool you bought for one job
signs.message: That gadget worked once. Give it one more real task.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the corner where the light is
signs.message: Move to the bright side of the room. Better afternoon, instantly.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the plan you would regret cancelling
signs.message: You'd be annoyed at yourself by midnight. Go anyway, briefly.

reasons: Monkey and Rat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the door held for someone slower
signs.message: Hold it a beat longer. Costs you nothing today.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Running late by a hair. Walk normal speed, nobody notices.

reasons: Horse opposes Rat — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: a thing kept because it was given
signs.message: You keep it out of guilt. That decision keeps till whenever.
